title: Every Replica Has the Same Accidental Delete
description: An accidental DELETE reaches all replicas before anyone notices. Which recovery mechanism addresses this failure?

options.text: Add another current replica after the deletion.
options.explanation: It copies the already-deleted state and does not recreate historical data.

options.text: Use tested base backups and archived logs for point-in-time recovery.
options.explanation: Independent recovery data lets you restore to before the mistake. Replicas mainly support read capacity and availability, not protection from faithfully replicated errors.
An up-to-date replica has replayed the same delete.
Connection recovery cannot restore committed data.
